prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE transparent game furniture sprite for Toy Room. Reference image: the supplied environment atlas is the mandatory STYLE reference, especially the painted red toy chest and round oak table. Create a small child-sized RED UPHOLSTERED ARMCHAIR, immediately recognizable, three-quarter front view with front facing viewer, subtle top view matching those furniture sprites. Required: tall rounded padded backrest, two substantial upholstered armrests, recessed soft seat cushion clearly separate from back, red warm woven fabric texture, visible seams/piping, subtle tufts, short oak feet, credible painted volume and soft integrated contact shadow. Same warm illustrated digital painting, material detail, soft upper-left golden lighting, dark warm outlines, premium children's fantasy game as the atlas. NOT a chest, NOT a throne, no yellow panel or blue circle, no geometric flat fills, no photorealism, no text or labels, no surrounding room. Transparent background, preserve shadow with alpha, full object with small transparent margins.
